text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we won! We're using this spot 
today.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What was that...? My body felt so heavy, I 
couldn't move the way I wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tap. This is really hard to say, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"A bunch of my buddies had their birthdays 
close together, right? And I celebrated 
every single one with a big feast, right? 
So that's why—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Stop! I get it, but that's not true. It's 
my own lack of oversight!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely get back into shape and 
return. Believe in me and wait for me!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We've run quite a lot, so let's wrap it 
up here for today—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No! No compromises! Not until I can hold 
my head high when meeting everyone...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by continuing to discipline 
herself, Tap Dance City reclaimed her 
ideal physique!
